subject: Can I use relative positioning for annotations in ggplot2?

messages.author: d080579ce00af5e9
messages.subject: Can I use relative positioning for annotations in ggplot2?
parts:
I am using geom_text to annotate plots in gglot2 and I want use
relative positioning rather than absolute. That is, I want a position
of (0.5, 0.5) to be dead center regardless of the x and y axis limits.
Is that possible?

Alternatively I could of course transform a relative position to an
absolute one if I had the x and y limits. Is it possible to extract
those from a plot?

messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: Can I use relative positioning for annotations in ggplot2?
parts:
Hi,

you cannot use relative positioning for geom_text.
But you can draw directly on the panel region:

qplot(1:3, 1:3)
pan <- grid.get(gPath("layout", "panel"), grep = T)
seekViewport(pan$vp) # set viewport to panel
grid.text("hoge")


In the next version of ggplot2, probably you can extract the x and y
limits after plotting,
so you can get limits and re-plot with the limits and new geoms.

kohske
